title: Customer Strata: segmentation tactics & renewal risk playbook (WIP)
summary: Working sheet (WIP) combining tiering, ICP-fit, deployment mode and regional signals into a single renewal-prioritization rubric for QBRs. Focused on pragmatic scoring that ties to playbook actions and owner responsibilities.
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a working customer-stratification sheet to be used by CSMs and AE partners during QBR prep and renewal planning. It produces a single renewal risk / priority score by combining: tier, ICP fit, deployment mode, region, usage signals, support activity, and quality indicators (evals/NPS).

Design goals (constraints):
- Simple arithmetic scoring so spreadsheets and small tools can calculate without a backend.
- Outputs map directly to actions (outreach cadence, exec involvement, discounts/credits, technical remediation).
- Distinguish commercial risk vs technical risk so we route to AE or Solutions Eng as appropriate.
- Make it auditable: include last-touch, open tickets, and top prompt regressions.

Scoring rubric (example weights, tunable):
- Tier weight (company value): 25 points
  - Tier A: 25, Tier B: 18, Tier C: 8
- ICP Fit: 20 points
  - Good fit (core use case, repeatable): 20, Partial: 12, Poor: 4
- Deployment risk (data/regulatory + private infra): 15 points
  - Private/on-prem w/ unattended upgrades: 12 (higher risk), Dedicated: 10, Hosted: 6
- Region/strategic priority: 10 points
  - Target expansion region (NA/EU/APAC) gets boosted weight: 10/7/5 based on GTM plan
- Usage & growth signal: 15 points
  - Growth > 30% QoQ: 15, flat: 8, declining: 2
- Support & SRE friction: 10 points
  - >10 P1/P2 in 90d or open escalations: 2-4, occasional: 6, none: 10
- Quality indicators (NPS/evals/regressions): 5 points
  - NPS>50 or zero regressions: 5, NPS 20-50: 3, below 20 or major regressions: 0

Total: 100 points. Priority buckets (recommended actions):
- 85-100: Immediate / Executive play (Top50 list)
  - Action: Exec QBR + renewal discussion 120d out, AE+CS+Solutions+Legal engaged, pricing lock options, dedicated resources for migration/PRs.
- 65-84: High priority
  - Action: Senior CSM & AE cadence, technical healthcheck, offer pilot for optimization credits, evaluate Dedicated commitment.
- 45-64: Monitor (mid)
  - Action: Standard QBR cadence, targeted prompts/eval catch-up, proactive automation suggestions from Optimize.
- <45: Low touch / Renew if baseline
  - Action: Self-serve enablement, NPS improvement program, monitor for changes.

Sample rows (CSV-style) - use in spreadsheet as source of truth:
customer_id,company,tier,ICP_fit,deploy_mode,region,tokens_last_30d,growth_30d,open_p1_90d,NPS_30d,score,priority_note
REDW-COM-001,Acme Retail,Tier A,Good,Hosted,NA,25M,+42%,0,56,89,Immediate: AE + exec QBR; consider 12mo Dedicated proposal
REDW-ENT-103,FinWave,Tier B,Partial,Dedicated,EU,9M,-5%,2,30,58,High: schedule solutions healthcheck; escalate 1 P1 backlog
REDW-START-422,NoteFlow,Tier C,Poor,Hosted,APAC,0.5M,+2%,0,12,21,Low: focus MQL enablement; no special pricing

Data sources to populate fields (operational integrations):
- Billing/usage (tokens/month) -> Finance / billing export
- Console telemetry (latency, error rates, cache-hit) -> Observability dashboards (link in sync)
- Support tickets (SRE & CSM) -> Zendesk/Jira CSV export
- Eval/regression results -> Research/Applied ML evals repo
- Region/GTM priority -> GTM roadmap doc

Playbook mapping (what to do at each priority):
- Immediate:
  - 120d before renewal: AE outreach, CSM builds exec deck, PS/SE scoping call for outstanding tech debt, legal pre-reads, propose pricing/commitment options.
  - 60d: finalize contract terms, reserve Dedicated capacity if requested, communicate migration plan.
  - 30d: executive sign-off, mobilize onboarding/oncall for cutover.
- High:
  - 90d: senior CSM + Solutions call, show Optimize impact (cost savings), run targeted evals on 3 regressions, prepare mitigation plan.
  - 30d: present commercial options (discount moments tied to usage milestones).
- Monitor:
  - Standard QBR cadence (quarterly), enable self-serve playbooks, light PS offers as outcome of healthcheck.
- Low:
  - Automated renewal nudges, targeted enablement content, track for spikes (alerts into CS queue).

Tactical runbook items for CSMs (checklist):
- Pre-QBR (owner = CSM): validate tokens_last_30d + growth; pull top 3 customer prompts that failed regression tests; confirm open tickets and SLA breaches; confirm decision makers present for QBR; update scorecard.
- Technical touch (owner = SE available): run 30-min healthcall; validate cache/KV hit rates; propose batching/quantization levers if cost is a concern.
- Commercial touch (owner = AE): map contract end date, min commitment levers, opportunity to cross-sell Dedicated or Private.
- Escalation path: if score <45 and sudden usage drop >30% or >2 P1s in 30d -> auto-create CS-evangelism ticket and route to pulpit channel for 24h SLA.

Open questions / TODOs (WIP):
- We currently underweight legal/regulatory friction for high-risk regulated customers; should deployment risk get higher weight for Finance/Legal signoff?
- Region prioritization: need GTM input to convert region into numeric boost (link to GTM calendar).
- How do we instrument prompt-level regressions into automated alerts and link to the Scorecard? (SE action item: CS-4987)
- Confirm mapping of tiers -> ARR bands with Finance (current tiers are approximate).

Owner notes / notes to self:
- This is intentionally conservative on hosted customers; Dedicated/private customers carry hidden ops costs and often require SE/infra support during renewals.
- Use this as the source-of-truth for QBR invites next quarter; export top-50 Immediate list by 2026-03-01 for exec review.

Appendix: Quick formulas for spreadsheet implementers
- normalized_score = TierScore + ICPScore + DeployScore + RegionScore + UsageScore + SupportScore + QualityScore
- TierScore = if(Tier=="Tier A",25,if(Tier=="Tier B",18,8))
- ICPScore = round(20 * ICP_fit_percent) where ICP_fit_percent is 0..1 mapping (Good=1,Partial=0.6,Poor=0.2)
- DeployScore = choose by deploy_mode: {Private:12,Dedicated:10,Hosted:6}
- UsageScore = if(growth_30d>0.3,15,if(growth_30d>0,8,2))

Next steps (owners):
- CSM leadership: agree on final weights by 2026-03-12 (Priya)
- GTM: confirm region boosts and list of strategic accounts (Lina)
- SE: prototype prompt-regression export to CSV and attach to each customer scorecard (Arjun)
- Product/Research: provide a routine eval reg test for all Tier A customers to feed the QualityScore (Evan)

Status: Draft. Ready for CS leadership review and GTM alignment.
